<script lang="ts">
import type { Variants } from 'motion-v'
import type { IconProps } from '@animate-ui/vue/icons'

export type LinkProps = IconProps<keyof typeof animations>;

export const animations = {
  default: {
    path1: {
      initial: { x: 0, y: 0 },
      animate: {
        x: [0, 1, 0],
        y: [0, -1, 0],
        transition: {
          duration: 0.6,
          times: [0, 0.4, 1],
          ease: ['easeOut', 'backOut'],
        },
      },
    },
    path2: {
      initial: { x: 0, y: 0 },
      animate: {
        x: [0, -1, 0],
        y: [0, 1, 0],
        transition: {
          duration: 0.6,
          times: [0, 0.4, 1],
          ease: ['easeOut', 'backOut'],
        },
      },
    },
  } satisfies Record<string, Variants>,
  'default-loop': {
    path1: {
      initial: { x: 0, y: 0 },
      animate: {
        x: [0, 1, 0],
        y: [0, -1, 0],
        transition: {
          duration: 0.8,
          times: [0, 0.4, 1],
          ease: ['easeOut', 'backOut'],
        },
      },
    },
    path2: {
      initial: { x: 0, y: 0 },
      animate: {
        x: [0, -1, 0],
        y: [0, 1, 0],
        transition: {
          duration: 0.8,
          times: [0, 0.4, 1],
          ease: ['easeOut', 'backOut'],
        },
      },
    },
  } satisfies Record<string, Variants>,
  unlink: {
    path1: {
      initial: { x: 0, y: 0, transition: { duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeInOut' } },

        x: 1,

        transition: { duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeInOut' },

    },
    path2: {
      initial: { x: 0, y: 0, transition: { duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeInOut' } },
      animate: {
        x: -1,
        y: 1,
        transition: { duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeInOut' },
      },
    },
  } satisfies Record<string, Variants>,
  join: {
    path1: {
      initial: {
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        pathLength: 1,
        transition: {
          duration: 0.4,
          ease: 'easeInOut',

      animate: {
        x: -1.5,
        y: 1.5,
        pathLength: 0.85,
        transition: {
          duration: 0.4,
          ease: 'easeInOut',
        },

    },
    path2: {
      initial: {
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        pathLength: 1,
        transition: {
          duration: 0.4,
          ease: 'easeInOut',
        },
      },
      animate: {
        x: 1.5,
        y: -1.5,
        pathLength: 0.85,
        transition: {
          duration: 0.4,
          ease: 'easeInOut',
        },
      },
    },
  } satisfies Record<string, Variants>,
  'join-loop': {
    path1: {
      initial: {
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        pathLength: 1,
        transition: {
          duration: 0.4,
          ease: 'easeInOut',
        },
      },
      animate: {
        x: [0, -1.5, 0],
        y: [0, 1.5, 0],
        pathLength: [1, 0.85, 1],
        transition: {
          duration: 0.8,
          ease: 'easeInOut',
        },
      },
    },
    path2: {
      initial: {
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        pathLength: 1,
        transition: {
          duration: 0.4,
          ease: 'easeInOut',
        },
      },
      animate: {
        x: [0, 1.5, 0],
        y: [0, -1.5, 0],
        pathLength: [1, 0.85, 1],
        transition: {
          duration: 0.8,
          ease: 'easeInOut',
        },
      },
    },
  } satisfies Record<string, Variants>,

</script>
